<!--
HTML only, on purpose. MathJax reads the definitions above and registers them
for the page; the .hidden wrapper stops the (empty) display equation showing.

PDF gets the SAME macros from tex/macros.tex via include-in-header in
_quarto.yml. Keeping the two paths separate matters: if both fired, LaTeX would
hit \newcommand on an already-defined macro and abort. tex/macros.tex therefore
uses \providecommand as a second line of defence.

If you add a macro, add it in BOTH files.
-->
